parsed.rationale: One participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under both 'Examples/' and 'WallpaperSampleApp/' in the path — a canonical sample-app location. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where a record resides under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers sample-app-mirror no-action regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. Consolidating the duplicate 'DebugMetricsProvider.init' initializer would couple the production 'DebugPanel' package to demonstration-context semantics in the 'Wallpaper' sample app, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. No override is warranted because there is no evidence in the cluster row that the sample-app record is a leftover prototype slated for deletion rather than a deliberate fixture.
